description: This file defines an interface IGrainDirectoryResolver within the Orleans.Runtime.GrainDirectory namespace. The interface provides a method for resolving a grain directory based on a grain type and properties, facilitating the association between grain types and their directories in Orleans runtime.

classes.name: IGrainDirectoryResolver
classes.description: Interface for resolving grain directories based on grain type and properties.

methods.name: TryResolveGrainDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to resolve and retrieve an IGrainDirectory instance for a given GrainType and GrainProperties, returning true if successful.
